title: Recursive NAND decision tree
statement: Define a decision tree for each depth $d$ and recursive NAND seed at depth $d$, on $2^d$ sign coordinates. At depth zero it queries the sole coordinate and returns its sign; at each subsequent depth it recursively builds trees on the two halves, combines them in the order selected by the seed, and computes their NAND.
hypotheses_covered: Seed belongs to the recursively defined seed space at that depth
